messages:
maria: quick heads-up, i ran a coverage sweep across gateway / auth / console / billing / runtime. found a handful of missing audit events and a few schema drifts that will block customer evidence bundles.

dan: quick TL;DR?

maria: inline: gateway: no token_refresh & rate_limit_rejected events; auth: missing sso_provision + mfa_change; console: new UX not emitting admin_role_update and api_key_rotate; billing: invoice_download and refund_issue not logged; runtime: model_fallback_switch and kv_cache_eviction absent. also inconsistent identity field names (user_id vs actor_id).

eric: can you show a before/after snippet for the schema mismatch so i can forward to ingestion folks?

maria: sure, sample below:

```
// current
{"event_type":"role.change","user_id":123,"details":{...}}

// target
{"event_type":"role.change","actor_id":"user:123","target_id":"user:456","action":"grant","roles":["admin"],"ts":"2025-11-02T15:04:05Z"}
```

jen: for the customer-facing evidence bundle, what fields are mandatory? auditors will ask for a minimum set.

maria: minimal evidence payload I sketched:

```
{"ts":"ISO8601","actor":"principal:email","request_id":"uuid","event_type":"string","outcome":"success|failure","request_path":"string","meta":{}}
```

maria: rule: every service must emit request_id + request_path. if missing, flag with blocking severity.

dan: question: for kms ops should we include key_id and key_version in the event? security wants cryptographic proof for rotations.

eric: yes include key_id, key_version, envelope_id, and a flag for HSM vs managed KMS. example:

```
{"event_type":"kms.decrypt","actor":"svc:runtime","key_id":"projects/prod/keys/abc","key_version":"v3","envelope_id":"enc-123","hsm_managed":true,"success":true}
```

maria: runtime note: sampling is heavy for token-level metrics. make sure cache hit/miss events are low-cardinality and never include prompt contents.

jen: ownership? who takes gateway and console fixes?

maria: assigning: dan -> gateway, eric -> runtime, jen -> console UX events, i'll own billing. i'll create backlog tasks.

dan: I'll open PRs in gateway repo to add the two events + schema tests. aiming EOD Thu for PR + linking the failing payloads.

eric: runtime will add kv_cache_eviction + model_fallback events, add unit tests for request_id propagation. ETA next Tue.

jen: console PR will map new UI actions to audit table and change admin flow to emit actor/target. I'll run an e2e using a fake-customer evidence bundle.

audit-bot: [ingest] 32 events failed schema validation in last 24h (svc=gateway, code=E_SCHEMA). see /internal/audit/errors/3605 for samples.

maria: noted. dan, please prioritize schema-breaking payloads that are blocking ingestion.

dan: ack. i'll triage the error list and attach failing payloads to the PR so ingestion can validate fixes.

jen: let's add contract checks in CI asserting required fields: request_id, actor_id, event_type, ts, outcome.

eric: idea: short-term pipeline shim to backfill request_id for retriable events if request_path+trace_id exist. we should only use it as a bridge, not long-term.

maria: fine as an ops-only mitigation but do not invent actor fields. only backfill request_id when trace_id present. put proposal in backlog as an ops patch with clear TTL.

dan: i'll draft a one-pager for legal on what constitutes a customer evidence bundle and share in #legal-review tomorrow.

maria: triage plan summary: 1) quick wins (gateway rate-limit + request_id) -> hotfix, 2) medium (schema standardization, console) -> sprint work, 3) heavy (billing invoice audit + legal sign-off) -> cross-team kickoff next week. will tag ticket priorities in backlog.

jen: thanks — i'll link the e2e test plan once PR is open.

eric: i'll include unit tests and ingestion integration smoke tests with samples.

dan: will surface any tricky legacy clients that emit user_id instead of actor_id so we can decide migration vs adapter.

maria: closing this thread. owners: dan/gateway, eric/runtime, jen/console, maria/billing. i'll create the issues and link to PRs. follow-ups will happen in the individual PR threads. :white_check_mark:
